in_marathi.name: Bapa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bapa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The term 'Bapa' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Pitra', which translates to 'father' in English. In Hindu mythology, Bapa is a revered title used for the deity Lord Vishnu, who is often considered the preserver of the universe. This name embodies the qualities of protection, nurturing, and strength.
